title: UTM Check
description: Stops campaign links that fragment analytics by catching, as the URL is built or pasted, mixed case and spaces (Facebook vs facebook, "Diwali Sale" vs diwali_sale, or a value your reports already spell differently), source and medium swapped, a medium GA4's default channel rules file as organic or Unassigned, misspelled keys, a second "?", tags after "#" and tags on links back to your own site, reading back the GA4 channel and fixing each in one tap or all at once.
